title: Momoi Airi — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Airi! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Good luck on your birthday stream today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks! I hope you're excited for it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on, what do you look so happy about...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, seeing everyone wish you a happy birthday since this morning, I just can't help feeling happy myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez... I appreciate that, but we have our stream after school today. Don't get too up in the clouds, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: A-Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait... Ayumi? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Um... I was thinking we could have lunch together, if you don't mind... What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She made the effort to come invite me... But I have to get things ready for the stream now.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The three of us can get things ready for the stream, Airi. Why don't you two have lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. Since you're offering, I'll take you up on that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's go, Ayumi! Does the courtyard sound good?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah. Sorry, I know you're busy.
But...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I'm really happy we get to hang out, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
It's your birthday, right?
I was going to send a message, but I decided I wanted to celebrate with you in person.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ayumi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you! I'm happy we get to hang out too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, is everyone ready to wish Airi a happy birthday? Here we go...

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Happy bday, Airi!!!>
<Happy birthday! I'm your fan forever!!>
<Thank you for being born into this world, Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa, there's so many comments!
Uhh, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
They're coming in too fast, I can't keep up...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone!
I'll be sure to read each of your comments later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I got birthday wishes from a lot of people at school, and now I'm getting so many more... This is such a wonderful day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm happy for you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, we've prepared something in hopes of making this wonderful birthday even more wonderful... A gift for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A gift?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ta-daaa! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's a big box!
It has six sides... And this is about the size of my head, no?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Something of this size...
Hehe. I wonder what could be inside.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi. Untie the ribbon and take off the lid.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right! Then, here I go...
One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh no! The box fell apart...
Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow... The box opened up like a flower... And there are photos on each petal...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe, did we surprise you?
It's a photo album in the shape of a gift box!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We wanted something that would make you feel excited each time you open it, and decided on this after asking around for ideas.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So that's the deal... It really did surprise me!
I thought I broke it the moment I opened it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That must've looked great on camera.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Still, there are so many pictures... This one's from that time we did a show for Saki on the school roof, and this one's from the school trip...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A lot of people must have helped out with this.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you! This is such a nice present, with so many memories packed in!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That album's super cute...>
<I freaked out 'cause I thought Airi broke her present.>
<It's great how they went the extra mile...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm glad you like it!
But Airi, this isn't our only gift for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, there's something else?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! For your next gift... Shizuku, please do the honors!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course! Here we...go.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait... Wh-What's with the huge cake?!
This has gotta be the size of one of our school desks!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is a specially made matcha cake.
We got together with some of your loving juniors and went all out to make it♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This size...isn't something you get by “going all out”...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Wait, huh? First I got a photo album, and now a big cake... That means...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess this surprise plan was in motion way earlier than I thought.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Ena, Mizuki, all my friends and juniors... And everyone in MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So many people made this happen for me...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you so much for this surprise, everyone!
The album and the cake both make me positively delighted!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad to see you're so happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! That means our surprise was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still... I can't let things end without giving something back.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Once we've had our cake, the special birthday show is next!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Special birthday show?!?!>
<Today's your special day, but you're gonna do a show for us?!>
<My eyes are wide open.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I want all of you watching the stream to get ready for the excitement!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As thanks for your birthday wishes, I'll sing with everything I've got. So look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Momoi.
I guess you're still looking out for Ena all the time... I don't think it could hurt to be the one making tall orders of her once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I wish you a very happy birthday, Momoi.
Ena and Mizuki were both really excited about getting your surprise ready, so I hope you'll let them know what you thought.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Airi!
You were suuuper cute when you got all surprised by that album☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We talked about how thinking the box broke would definitely make you jump, so it really was a complete success.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We went through some trial and error with the shape of the box to make it look like a beautiful flower when opened...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, the mechanism that makes it open up when the lid is removed seems to have worked perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! We weren't expecting Shizuku to come with us for this sort of help, but we couldn't be happier that the surprise succeeded! Once again, Airi Momoi, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We all watched your stream.
It made us happy to see how much you liked your surprise gifts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki was very particular about which photos to include in the album. She pored over photos of you for hours, picking out which photos should go in one by one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Though, there was a chunk of time in the middle where she was more focused on looking than choosing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahhh! Shiho, that's our secret, remember?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But still! I made it my job to pick out the very best photos of you, Airi! I also gave special attention to how the album was decorated, so I hope you'll look at every nook and cranny♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm glad you liked the matcha cake!
I'd never really made something that big before, so I was kinda worried it might not have turned out well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was super good when we taste-tested, right? You've got nothing to worry about!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let us know what you thought when you get a chance, Airi!
Have a great birthday!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Woohoo! Our surprise was a huge success♪
C'mon, Airi, how was it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way... Kanade also helped decorate the album!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. We made sure to include the balloon-shaped origami you cut out, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That was my first time touching origami in a long while... I'm glad you seemed to enjoy the album, Momoi.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right, it's great that it went so well.
It was nice to see you looking so happy, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'll say this again... Happy birthday, Airi.
I'll keep celebrating it as many times as you'll let me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Airi!
Phew, it was so nerve-wracking thinking you might find out about the album or the cake!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was. There were several moments when I almost let something slip...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that could've been bad...
Still, things went off without a hitch... And above all else, I'm so glad that you seem to be enjoying yourself so much, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Getting help from everyone, I realized all over again that sooo many people just adore you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! And seeing so many people celebrate your birthday even filled me with joy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We wish you a very happy birthday, Airi.
Let's continue delivering hope to everyone going forward!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you so much for all the birthday wishes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Feeling so much love makes me all the more certain that I need to deliver more and more hope.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All this to say, I'm able to remain an idol for another day because I have you cheering me on!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I hope you'll keep watching me as I take more steps forward!
